apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx.name: App root
apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx.description: The phone app's root layout that wraps every screen.

apps/mobile/app/(settings)/_layout.tsx.name: Settings layout
apps/mobile/app/(settings)/_layout.tsx.description: The layout around the settings screens.

apps/mobile/app/(settings)/integrations..name: Capabilities screen
apps/mobile/app/(settings)/integrations..description: Everything agents can use now, the same report and labels as the web.

apps/mobile/app/(settings)/models.tsx.name: Models screen
apps/mobile/app/(settings)/models.tsx.description: The owner's AI model providers and routing settings.

apps/mobile/app/(settings)/notify-settin.name: Notifications settings
apps/mobile/app/(settings)/notify-settin.description: How agents may reach the owner.

apps/mobile/app/(settings)/running.tsx.name: What-is-running screen
apps/mobile/app/(settings)/running.tsx.description: Every process in the owner's workspace with the agent that started it; stop one or all of them.

apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx.name: Tab bar
apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx.description: The four main tabs — chats, updates, tasks and settings — under one floating bar.

apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx.name: Chats tab
apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx.description: The chats list: header, filters, every agent and group as a row, and the unified search.

apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/tasks.tsx.name: Tasks tab
apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/tasks.tsx.description: The agents' runs as they are now.

apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/updates.tsx.name: Updates tab
apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/updates.tsx.description: What needs the owner across all agents.

apps/mobile/app/+not-found.tsx.name: Not-found screen
apps/mobile/app/+not-found.tsx.description: The screen shown for an address that does not exist.

apps/mobile/app/agents.tsx.name: Manage agents screen
apps/mobile/app/agents.tsx.description: Every agent with its role and on/off state, every group with its size, and creating a group.

apps/mobile/app/archived.tsx.name: Archived screen
apps/mobile/app/archived.tsx.description: The archived conversations, with un-archive and the keep-archived setting.

apps/mobile/app/artifacts.tsx.name: Files screen
apps/mobile/app/artifacts.tsx.description: Searches and lists the owner's files by agent.

apps/mobile/app/bot-settings.tsx.name: Agent settings screen
apps/mobile/app/bot-settings.tsx.description: One agent's identity, memory, model, permissions and market.

apps/mobile/app/owner.tsx.name: What-I-know-about-you screen
apps/mobile/app/owner.tsx.description: Every line of the owner profile with where it came from.

apps/mobile/app/routine.tsx.name: Routine screen
apps/mobile/app/routine.tsx.description: Creates and edits a scheduled routine.

apps/mobile/app/server.tsx.name: Server address screen
apps/mobile/app/server.tsx.description: Where the owner enters the server address.

apps/mobile/app/sign-in.tsx.name: Sign-in screen
apps/mobile/app/sign-in.tsx.description: Signs the owner in, or sets up a new server's owner; a confirmed Lonora link's setup code fills that form, only for the server the link named.

apps/mobile/app/skills.tsx.name: Skills screen
apps/mobile/app/skills.tsx.description: An agent's skills: view, create and manage versions.

apps/mobile/app/thread.tsx.name: Conversation screen
apps/mobile/app/thread.tsx.description: The main chat screen where the owner talks to an agent; the largest screen in the app.

apps/mobile/app/connect.tsx.name: Connect from a link
apps/mobile/app/connect.tsx.description: Asks the owner to confirm the server a Lonora link points to, then switches the app to it and opens sign-in.
